integrity: The exact block singular spectrum and state/operator constructions are credited to the motivating source. The new claim and proof concern the exact high-index coefficient using difference grouping and pinching. Numerical checks supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only for the specified integrable gate and initial operator or domain-wall state; fixed alpha>1; infinite volume first. Multiplicative constants, the alpha=1 crossover, other gates and finite-size recurrence are not established. Preliminary 2026-09-04 PDF was inaccessible and priority may be implicit in unindexed work.
title: The exact high-index Rényi coefficient in an integrable brickwork circuit
